verdict.rationale: Floot's sharing docs say you can add collaborators to a project, so team members can work on the same project. That is the core of the story. Nothing describes a team-level shared workspace, simultaneous editing, or permissions. Missing for 10: shared team/organization workspace, real-time or concurrent editing, collaborator roles and permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my team can work on the same project together in a shared workspace

citations.quote: add collaborators, send a development preview, send the whole project to another account, or make the project public
